from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote
import hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, zipfile

r = Path('/Users/agrudin/dev/my/ariadna')
p = Path('/private/tmp/ariadna-f18-0292')
base = '86c9c68039a3d7b19eb6b5d7942f8d774b96b514'
changed = {'CURRENT_STATE.md', 'docs/adr/README.md', 'openspec/ROADMAP.md',
           'openspec/changes/refine-physical-trajectory/design.md',
           'openspec/changes/refine-physical-trajectory/tasks.md',
           'openspec/changes/refine-physical-trajectory/specs/research-trajectory-experiment/spec.md'}
new = {'docs/adr/0292-correct-artificial-interpreter-pin.md',
       'docs/adr/experiments/0292-correct-artificial-interpreter-pin.json',
       'docs/adr/experiments/0292-correct-artificial-interpreter-pin-evidence.zip'}
proof = 'docs/adr/experiments/0292-doc-verification.json'
def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=r, text=True).strip()
def pin(raw): return {'bytes': len(raw), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == base and git('branch', '--show-current') == 'dev'
assert not git('diff', '--cached', '--name-only')
assert set(git('diff', '--name-only').splitlines()) == changed
assert set(git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard').splitlines()) == new
protected = 0
for row in subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-rz', '--full-tree', base], cwd=r).split(b'\0'):
    if not row: continue
    metadata, name = row.split(b'\t', 1); name = name.decode()
    if name in changed: continue
    raw = (r / name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(raw)).encode() + b'\0' + raw).hexdigest() == metadata.decode().split()[2], name
    protected += 1
x = json.loads((r / 'docs/adr/experiments/0292-correct-artificial-interpreter-pin.json').read_bytes())
a = r / 'docs/adr/experiments' / x['archive']['name']
assert pin(a.read_bytes()) == {k: x['archive'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
with zipfile.ZipFile(a) as z:
    assert len(z.namelist()) == len(set(z.namelist())) == x['archive']['members'] and z.testzip() is None
    assert all(not Path(n).is_absolute() and '..' not in Path(n).parts for n in z.namelist())
    expanded = sum(i.file_size for i in z.infolist())
    assert expanded == x['archive']['expanded_bytes'] < 2097152
    d = {n: json.loads(z.read(n)) for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.json') and z.read(n)}
    scope, review, frozen, post = (d[n] for n in ('scope.json', 'candidate-code-review.json', 'candidate-source-pins.json', 'post-run-evidence-review.json'))
    assert scope['stage'] == 'F18.22' and scope['base_revision'] == base and scope['free_scientific_variables'] == []
    assert review['status'] == post['status'] == 'PASS' and not review['findings'] and not post['findings']
    assert review['file_pins'] == frozen['files'] and len(frozen['files']) == 3
    for path, expected in frozen['files'].items(): assert pin(z.read(str(Path(path).relative_to(p)))) == expected, path
    assert set(n for n in z.namelist() if n.startswith('controls/')) == {'controls/native-entry.py', 'controls/supervisor-adapter.py'}
    for n in ('controls/native-entry.py', 'controls/supervisor-adapter.py', 'run-qualified-harness.py'):
        old = Path('/private/tmp/ariadna-f18-0291') / n
        before, after = (b'/private/tmp/ariadna-f18-0291/qualification', b'/private/tmp/ariadna-f18-0292/qualification') if n.startswith('controls/') else (b'/private/tmp/ariadna-f18-0291', b'/private/tmp/ariadna-f18-0292')
        assert z.read(n) == old.read_bytes().replace(before, after)
    source = d['source-seam-review.json']
    assert source['status'] == 'PASS' and source['base_revision'] == '9d55df2ad416a916c55bb3a26e6b17b2c02d7b12'
    for path, expected in source['file_pins'].items():
        q = Path(path)
        if q.is_relative_to(r):
            assert pin(subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', base + ':' + str(q.relative_to(r))], cwd=r)) == expected, path
        else:
            member = str(q.relative_to('/private/tmp/ariadna-f18-0290/retained-0286'))
            with zipfile.ZipFile(r / 'docs/adr/experiments/0286-single-completed-owner-evidence.zip') as prev: assert pin(prev.read(member)) == expected, path
    tool = d['tool-result.json']; obs = json.loads(tool['output']); ext = d['external-invocation.json']; result = d['qualification-result.json']
    assert tool == x['actual_tool_return'] and tool['exit_code'] == ext['exit_code'] == 0
    assert obs['status'] == 'PASS' and obs['observed_after_external_receipt_fsync_s'] == 0.6748446668498218 < 120
    assert ext['failure'] is None and not ext['cleanup']['errors'] and ext['stderr_bytes'] == 0
    assert ext['candidate_manifest_sha256'] == pin(z.read('candidate-source-pins.json'))['sha256']
    out = obs['stdout']; assert out['tests_run'] == result['tests_run'] == 10 and out['failures'] == out['errors'] == result['failures'] == result['errors'] == 0
    assert result['test_success_observed'] is True and result['previously_passed_helper_methods_repeated'] == []
    assert len(result['selected_methods']) == 10 and all(not n.startswith(('test_10_', 'test_11_', 'test_12_')) for n in result['selected_methods'])
    assert pin(z.read('qualification-result.json')) == {k: out['report_pin'][k] for k in ('bytes', 'sha256')}
    assert out['byte_counters'] == {'files':160, 'structured_bytes':360843, 'log_bytes':1586}
    assert len(result['case_observed_returns']) == 14
    assert all(0 <= c['elapsed_after_observation_directory_fsync_s'] < (60 if c['status'] == 'observed-injected-pass' else 65) for c in result['case_observed_returns'])
    log = z.read('qualification/unittest.log'); assert log.count(b'... ok') == 10 and b'Ran 10 tests' in log and b'\nOK\n' in log
    assert d['qualification/interpreter-pin-refusals.json']['wrong_sha256_refused'] is True
    assert d['qualification/interpreter-pin-refusals.json']['over16MiB_declared_input_refused'] is True
    assert x['artificial_slice_completion'] is True and x['new_native_authority'] is False and x['physical_admission'] == 'unavailable'
links = anchors = 0
for name in sorted(changed | {n for n in new if n.endswith('.md')}):
    for dest in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)', (r / name).read_text()):
        dest = dest.strip('<>')
        if '://' in dest or dest.startswith(('mailto:', 'data:')): continue
        file, _, frag = dest.partition('#'); q = ((r / name).parent / unquote(file)).resolve() if file else r / name
        if not q.exists(): assert q == r / proof, (name, dest)
        links += 1
        if frag and q.suffix == '.md':
            titles = re.findall(r'^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*$', q.read_text(), re.M)
            slugs = {re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', t.strip().lower().replace('`', '')).replace(' ', '-') for t in titles}
            assert unquote(frag) in slugs, (name, dest); anchors += 1
assert len((r / 'CURRENT_STATE.md').read_text().splitlines()) < 60
tasks = (r / 'openspec/changes/refine-physical-trajectory/tasks.md').read_text()
assert '- [x] F18.21 ' in tasks and '- [x] F18.22 ' in tasks and '- [ ] F18.23 ' in tasks
subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--check'], cwd=r, check=True)
v = subprocess.run(['openspec', 'validate', 'refine-physical-trajectory', '--strict'], cwd=r, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert v.returncode == 0, v.stdout + v.stderr
out = {'schema':'ariadna.f18.corrected-slice-documentary-check.v1', 'status':'PASS', 'base_revision':base,
       'protected_prior_blobs':protected, 'local_links':links, 'anchors':anchors,
       'archive_members':x['archive']['members'], 'archive_expanded_bytes':expanded,
       'archive_compressed_bytes':a.stat().st_size, 'strict_openspec':{'exit_code':v.returncode,'stdout':v.stdout,'stderr':v.stderr},
       'checked_files':{n:pin((r / n).read_bytes()) for n in sorted(changed | new)},
       'unchanged_full_suite_repeated':False, 'new_scientific_native_work':False,
       'scope':'Corrected artificial slice and documentary accuracy only; no native admission'}
with (p / 'doc-checks.json').open('x') as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True); f.write('\n'); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in out.items() if k != 'checked_files'}))
